title: Single-Photon Holonet Demonstrator Runbook
source_basis: BT1895 demonstrator-vs-fault-tolerant stack compiler plus uploaded Holonet build-sheet anchors
goal: Convert the single-photon demonstrator into an executable experimental sequence with raw data columns and pass/fail criteria.
components: classical controller for Witting frame schedule
run_sequence: separately tag 160 diagonal contextual witness apertures and 480 off-diagonal data handshakes
run 72-tick transaction body per accepted frame
compute witness metrics and compare to pass/fail criteria

frame_split.target: 160 diagonal witness records + 480 off-diagonal data records

pass_fail.schedule_integrity: all 640 physical frame records attempted with correct tetrad/slot labels
pass_fail.admission_integrity: accepted logical count matches 520/1600 within declared shot-noise interval
pass_fail.contextuality: contextual-fraction estimate compatible with 1/10 after dark/loss correction
pass_fail.topological_pump: Chern readout compatible with 2 under the chosen pump protocol
pass_fail.guarding: dark-reference and loss-probe estimates reported separately; do not fold them into the contextual-fraction estimate without correction

boundary: Runbook for the unencoded single-photon demonstrator only; not the GKP(D4) fault-tolerant machine and not a hardware threshold claim.
